WIPRO.about: Wipro Limited operates as an information technology (IT), consulting, and business process services company worldwide. It operates through IT Services and IT Products segments. The company was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

WEWORK.about: WeWork India Management Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the rental and operation of office buildings and coworking spaces in India. The company offers office spaces, including private and managed offices; coworking spaces; and value-added services such as fit-out customization, events and hospitality, F&B services, technology services, overages, shoots and studios, parking, and solutions for global capability centers. It also provides advertising services through digital signage, ads in community newsletters, tabletops and standees, in-app and email notifications, and brand promotional spaces. In addition, the company operates Rivet, a design and build workspace company that provides existing site analysis and technical due diligence, spatial and space type planning, design concepts, electro-mechanical design, building management system integration and IoT design, arts and graphics, wayfinding and signage, project management, testing and commissioning, and documentation and handover of fit-out services. Further, it offers digital products comprising WeWork All Access, a monthly coworking membership that gives individuals and teams access to WeWork centers; Virtual Office, which provides members with a registered address for company incorporation, GST, and statutory filings; WeWork On-Demand, a flexible pay-per-use access to WeWork; and WeWork Workplace, a SaaS platform for workspace management. The company serves Fortune 500 companies, large enterprises, global capability centers, mid-sized businesses, startups, and independent professionals. WeWork India Management Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

WINDMACHIN.about: Windsor Machines Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of plastic processing machinery in India and internationally. It operates through the Injection Moulding Machine, Pipe Extrusion, and and Blown Film segment. The company offers injection molding machines that are used for various applications, including households, thermoware, furniture, healthcare, white goods, electrical and electronics, and automobile industries; pipe extrusion lines for applications, such as agriculture, drip irrigation, and potable drinking water solutions; and blown film lines. The company was formerly known as DGP Windsor India Limited and changed its name to Windsor Machines Limited in February 2005. Windsor Machines Limited was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

WHIRLPOOL.about: Whirlpool of India Limited manufactures and markets home appliances in India and internationally. It offers refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, microwave ovens, air fryer, kitchen, built-in, and small appliances, as well as dishwasher. The company sells its products through Internet. The company was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India. Whirlpool of India Limited operates as a subsidiary of Whirlpool Corporation.

WPIL.about: WPIL Limited, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, erects, commissions, and services pumps and pumping systems in India and internationally. It offers mixed and axial flow, as well as turbine; split case, multistage, end suction, and non clog; deepwell, drainage, sewage, and dewatering; concrete and metallic volutes, as well as pump turbine; vertical, horizontal, and system packages fire fighting solutions; and floating, gate, and axial flow submersible pumps. The company's products are used in water, irrigation, municipal, and energy applications. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1952 and is based in Kolkata, India.

WONDERLA.about: Wonderla Holidays Limited engages in the amusement park and resort business in India. The company operates through Amusement Parks and Resort, and Others segments. It operates amusement parks, rides, restaurants, banquet halls, food courts, and lounge bars. The company also provides hotel accommodation and other related services, as well as merchandise, cooked food, packed food, and beverages. Wonderla Holidays Limited was founded in 2000 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

WSI.about: W.S. Industries (India) Limited operates as infrastructure development and electrical project handling company in India and internationally. The company undertakes various civil infrastructure, such as drainage systems and integrated bus terminal and multi utility facility centers; and turnkey projects comprising design, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of HV and EHV substations and transmission lines, network quality regulation, eBOP, rural electrifications, R APDRP, renewables, RDSS, and electrical packages. W.S. Industries (India) Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Chennai, India.

WOCKPHARMA.about: Wockhardt Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a pharmaceutical and biotech company, in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It manufactures and trades pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemical, and botanical products, as well as chemicals and chemical products. The company also develops its flagship antibiotic, ZAYNICH zidebactam/cefepime, a novel beta lactam enhancer mechanism for the treatment of sepsis and hospital/ventilator associated pneumonia; FOVISCU, an antibiotic for gram-negative infections; MIQNAF nafithromycin, which targets azithromycin-resistant community respiratory pathogens; and ODRATE, a once-daily combination of ertapenem and zidebactam for resistant gram-negative infections through outpatient parenteral antimicrobial therapy. In addition, it develops and commercializes insulin analogs, glucagon-like peptide-1 agonists, and novel combination drug products; Biovac-B, a recombinant hepatitis-B vaccine; Wepox, a recombinant human erythropoietin; Wosulin, a recombinant human insulin; and Glaritus, a recombinant insulin glargine, as well as offers insulin aspart regular and biphasic drug products. Further, the company offers delivery devices for insulin, including DispoPen disposable pen and Mypen reusable pen. Wockhardt Limited was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

WSTCSTPAPR.about: West Coast Paper Mills Limited manufactures and sells pulp, paper, and paper boards in India and internationally. It operates through Paper, Cables, and Others segments. The company offers printing and writing paper, machine-glazed paper and boards, security and hi-value grades paper, cup stock and coated duplex boards, business stationery products, and premium printing paper under the WESCO brand, as well as optical fibers and optical fiber cables. It is also involved in the wind power generation business with a capacity of 74.8 megawatts. The company sells its products to the B2B and B2C markets through a network of distributors; banks; the printing, writing, publishing, stationery, notebook, packaging, telecommunications, infrastructure development, data center, utilities, and defense sectors; and government institutions. It exports its products to approximately 20 countries across the Asia Pacific, the Middle East, the Mediterranean, and the African subcontinents. The company was formerly known as The West Coast Paper Mills Limited and changed its name to West Coast Paper Mills Limited in September 2016. West Coast Paper Mills Limited was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
